example_sentences_in_bangla: শীতের আগমনে ঋতুপর্ণা গাছগুলো পাতা ঝরিয়ে ফেলে।
বন্য এলাকায় ঋতুপর্ণা বৃক্ষের সারি দেখতে অপূর্ব লাগে।
example_sentences_in_english: In the onset of winter, the deciduous trees shed their leaves.
The row of deciduous trees in the forest looks magnificent.
history: Refers to the natural seasonal changes observed in Bengali rural landscapes, particularly during autumn and winter.
note: This term is more of a descriptive phrase than a strictly idiomatic expression, rooted in observations of Bengal's monsoon-influenced climate.
